auth.registerSubtitle: Registration is open; modules are enabled by the admin on request.

modules.title: Modules
modules.subtitle: What you have enabled, and what you can ask the admin to enable.
modules.disabledByMe: Off (you can turn it back on)
modules.turnedOff: Module turned off — your data stays, it is only hidden
modules.emptyHint: Request access and the admin will enable them for you.

videos.title: Videos
videos.empty: No videos yet. Paste a link and it will be recognised automatically.
videos.urlHint: YouTube, Vimeo, Dailymotion or a direct .mp4 — the player is built from an allowlist; other links open externally.
videos.name: Title
videos.metaNoTitle: No title found — write your own
videos.metaNeedsKey: Duration and tags for YouTube need YOUTUBE_API_KEY in backend/.env.
videos.consentText: These entries are marked 18+. By confirming you state that you are of legal age and want to see them.
videos.imagesInfo: Photos attached to this entry. Stored with your account; for 18+ entries they go to the private disk.
videos.notesInfo: Your own notes about this entry — timestamps, thoughts, anything.
videos.docsInfo: PDF, Word, spreadsheets and text files attached to this entry.

admin.title: Admin
admin.pageSubtitle: Accounts, access requests and the module registry of this instance.
admin.storageHint: Only files this user uploaded. Posters downloaded from TMDB are shared between accounts.
admin.permissionsHint: A super admin passes every check. A disabled account cannot sign in.
admin.userModulesHint: Which modules this account may use. The user can hide an enabled module themselves — that does not revoke the grant.
admin.genreDeleteWarning: Genres are global: this affects {{movies}} movies and {{series}} series across all users.
admin.deleteUserHint: {{name}} and all of their records ({{movies}} movies, {{series}} series) will be deleted permanently.
admin.adminHasAllModules: A super admin always has every module.

sort.label: Sort
sort.groupOn: Franchise parts stay together — click to sort purely by the chosen field
sort.groupOff: Franchise parts are split apart — click to keep them together
sort.groupOffHint: Franchise parts are not kept together: they are sorted purely by the chosen field, so other movies can end up between them.

library.title: My collection
library.empty: No movies found — add a new one.
library.emptySeries: No series found — add a new one.

form.lookup: Quick fill — by link or title
form.lookupPlaceholder: Paste a ge.movie/IMDb link or a movie title
form.lookupPlaceholderSeries: Paste a ge.movie/IMDb link or a series title
form.lookupHint: Auto-fills poster, description, genres and cast from TMDB
form.alreadyAdded: This movie is already in your collection
form.alreadyAddedSeries: This series is already in your collection
form.posterHint: Choose an image from your computer
form.addSubtitle: Fill by link/title or by hand
form.editSubtitle: Update fields or re-sync from TMDB

detail.deleteConfirm: Delete this movie from your collection?

settings.title: Settings
settings.subtitle: Saved in this browser.
settings.listsHint: How many records are shown per page.
settings.discoverHint: TMDB serves 20 records per page and refuses page numbers above {{max}} — that is a hard API limit, not our setting.
settings.discoverPerPageHint: A multiple of 20 — several TMDB pages are merged into one.
settings.syncHint: Bulk operations over the whole collection.
settings.syncDesc: Pick a scope, see how many records it touches, then watch the progress in the queue — it can be stopped at any time.
settings.syncDelayHint: Gives TMDB some air on long runs.
settings.syncCli: For a one-off bootstrap on a fresh clone there is also: php artisan media:redownload --missing

sync.title: Sync from TMDB
sync.onlyMissingHint: Records whose files are all present are skipped without touching TMDB — much faster.
sync.modeEmptyHint: Your own text is never touched.
sync.modeOverwriteHint: TMDB data replaces what is already there — including text you wrote yourself.
sync.pickSomething: Pick at least one thing to update.

confirm.deleteMovieDesc: “{{title}}” will be permanently removed from your collection. Are you sure?

genres.title: Manage genres
genres.infoNames: The genre name in Georgian and English. The slug never changes, so TMDB sync keeps matching this genre.
genres.infoItems: Everything currently linked to this genre. Tick the records you want to act on — the selection is kept when you switch tabs.
genres.infoAdd: Link records that do not have this genre yet. Their other genres stay untouched.
genres.infoActions: Acts on the records ticked in the “Records” tab. Detach removes only this genre; Move swaps this genre for the target one; Replace drops all genres and leaves only the target.
genres.actNeedSelection: tick records in the “Records” tab first
genres.saveNamesHint: Saves the names. Record changes are applied immediately in their own tabs.
genres.deleteRequestedHint: Genres are global, so deletion needs admin approval.
genres.inUse: This genre has {{count}} records linked — it can't be deleted as-is. Choose what to do:
genres.optReassign: Move the records to another genre
genres.optLeaveEmpty: Leave them without a genre and delete it
genres.itemsEmpty: No records in this genre yet
genres.actHintMove: This genre is removed and the target added — other genres stay.
genres.actHintReplace: The selected records keep only the target genre.
genres.replaceConfirmDesc: {{count}} record(s) will keep only “{{name}}” — their other genres are removed.
genres.detachConfirmDesc: The genre will be removed from {{count}} record(s).
genres.newItemsHint: Optionally mark records into the new genre right away.

bulkStatus.title: Bulk status change
bulkStatus.subtitle: Change the status of a whole group or specific movies at once.
bulkStatus.confirmDesc: {{count}} movies will change status to "{{status}}". Continue?

toast.busy: Wait for the current action to finish
